raw_comment: I notice that the drought is the worst in the central USA; however, it is not very consistent or centralized in one area, so there may be different severities of drought in a state. For example, there are areas ranging from no drought to "Exceptional Drought" in Ohio alone. I wonder if this drought is related to our lifestyle or other world events. Another idea could be that this is related to global warming and is a notable way in which it is causing our climate to change. I also wonder if this drought is affecting bordering countries. This directly affects my community because I live in the United States, and a drought could impact my resources and therefore my day-to-day life. A catchy title for this graph would be "Newfound Drought Spans America."
